instruction: A candid outdoor photograph of a playful teambuilding activity in a grassy park. On the left, the bald man in the navy t-shirt (R2) stands laughing with his mouth wide open, holding a white inflatable bowling pin in his hand. On the right, the woman in the navy t-shirt (R4) stands in light blue jeans, raising a white inflatable bowling pin high above her head with both hands. They are positioned side-by-side on the green grass in front of a red and white banner. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows across the lawn.
